events.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a small screwdriver set, but I’m only there the first hour. I won’t say anything about the mailbox spot until you or Mara confirm it.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—I’ll mark you down for duct tape and a small screwdriver set for the first hour. I’ll hold off on mentioning any drop-off spot until Mara or I confirm it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: Rey, what I can confirm is that this Saturday is sign-ups only—no tool drop-off yet—and folks should list what they’re bringing so volunteers can prep.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep it quiet and just tell folks Saturday is for sign-ups and supply notes, not drop-offs yet.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Perfect, Rey—please also note I’m still waiting on the final time and exact sign-up spot, so I’ll send you those once they’re confirmed.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Hi Quinn — I’m still holding the repair drive details quietly for now, and I’ve kept Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door on the separate home-repair list like we said.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey—I appreciate you keeping it quiet. I’m still waiting on the layout and sign-up lead, so hold steady for now and I’ll give you the clean version as soon as it’s confirmed.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Got it, Quinn—I’ll hold steady and won’t pass anything along until you’ve got the clean version ready.
events.speaker: Rey
